Method of Attack: A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by crafting and submitting XML data containing malicious external entity references.
Impacted Systems: Java applications using Spring Web Services `spring-ws-core` and `spring-xml` packages
Attack Vector: XML External Entity (XXE) attacks. The attacker can leverage this vulnerability to perform various XXE related attacks against the server.
Indicators of Compromise: The processing of malicious XML external entities in multiple files throughout the component
